title: Witless
summary: WITLESS, adjective [wit and less.] 1. Destitute of wit or understanding; inconsiderate; wanting thought; as a witless swain; witless youth. 2. Indiscrete; not under the guidance of judgment; as witles

inlines.v: WITLESS, adjective [wit and less.] 1. Destitute of wit or understanding; inconsiderate; wanting thought; as a witless swain; witless youth. 2. Indiscrete; not under the guidance of judgment; as witless bravery.
